CHIEF COMPLAINT
Annual exam

HISTORY OF PRESENT ILLNESS
52-year-old female with past medical history of rheumatoid arthritis, atrial fibrillation, and reflux presents for annual exam. Patient has been following exercise recommendations with walking, yoga, and exercise over the past year, which has significantly improved her arthritis. Reports no recent joint pain, stiffness, or flare-ups. Currently taking methotrexate once weekly without issues. Regarding atrial fibrillation, patient reports ongoing palpitations with most recent episode approximately one week ago. Notes palpitations worsen with stress and has tried meditation and running to manage stress without significant improvement. Event monitor was placed last month. For reflux, patient eliminated soda from diet and has been on protonix with good response, with no flare-ups in over 5 months. Denies chest pain, shortness of breath, or nausea/vomiting.

REVIEW OF SYSTEMS
Patient endorsed palpitations and nasal congestion related to allergies on review of systems. Denies chest pain, shortness of breath, nausea, and vomiting.

PAST MEDICAL HISTORY
Rheumatoid arthritis, atrial fibrillation, reflux

MEDICATIONS
Methotrexate 2.5 mg once weekly, protonix 40 mg daily

ALLERGIES
Not discussed.

FAMILY HISTORY
Not discussed.

SOCIAL HISTORY
Patient exercises regularly including walking, yoga, and running with her dog. Has made dietary modifications including eliminating soda.

PHYSICAL EXAMINATION
Vital signs: Heart rate well-controlled. Cardiovascular: 2/6 systolic ejection murmur appreciated (previously noted), regular rate and rhythm. Pulmonary: lungs clear. Musculoskeletal: edema and erythema on right elbow with pain to palpation. No lower extremity edema.

RESULTS
Event monitor: Intermittent atrial fibrillation with conversion pause (patient cycles between a-fib, pause, and regular rhythm).
Autoimmune panel: Well-controlled rheumatoid arthritis on current methotrexate therapy.

ASSESSMENT AND PLAN
1. Rheumatoid arthritis: Continue methotrexate 2.5 mg once weekly. Refill ordered. Consider rheumatology referral if needed.
2. Atrial fibrillation: Refer to cardiology for cardiac ablation to map and ablate source of arrhythmia.
3. Reflux: Continue protonix 40 mg daily. Continue dietary modifications avoiding coffee and spicy foods.
